title: Austin: Environment, Utilities & Employee Pay Talks
summary:
*   Discussions focused on environmental and conservation services for the city.
*   Review of proposed rules and regulations for utility customer service.
*   Consideration of a new wage and benefits package for city employees.
*   A dedicated session for citizens to provide input on policy briefings.
